authored_cards.definition: Request information about alarms or their configured state.
includes: Listing, checking existence, times or descriptions of alarms.
excludes: Creating, cancelling or silencing alone does not request information.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request deleting, disabling or cancelling an alarm notification.
includes: Removing one or all scheduled alarms.
excludes: Muting sound without disabling an alarm is not cancellation.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request creating or scheduling an alarm notification.
includes: Time, delay or explicitly directed conditional alarms, even without all parameters.
excludes: Appointments alone and generic reminders without alarm evidence do not imply an alarm.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request a relative reduction in audible output loudness while retaining sound.
includes: Lower/softer/quieter with expressed audio context; decrease to a nonzero target also expresses adjustment.
excludes: An absolute low level without comparative direction does not express this relative request. Zero/mute is silence, not retained-audio quieter. Unknown actual current level does not itself make a clearly absolute request unavailable.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request suppression of sound from the addressed audible source.
includes: Explicit mute/zero volume, stop speaking, or pause/stop identified audible playback.
excludes: Lower nonzero volume, unmute, or cancellation of a scheduled alarm alone does not request sound suppression. Stop alone or unspecified notifications/responses can leave the audible-source requirement unresolved.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request a relative increase in audible output loudness.
includes: Louder/raise/increase with audio context; an explicit higher target or louder speech qualifies.
excludes: Unmute or an absolute high/maximum level without comparative direction does not express relative increase. Playback speed or lighting brightness is not audio loudness.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request current audio volume or mute-state information.
includes: Read or verify the currently configured output level or mute status.
excludes: Changing a setting or opening its interface alone does not request current-state information. A bare request for settings may be ambiguous between current values and interface.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request setting or changing output loudness or an explicit mute/unmute control.
includes: Absolute volume, relative louder/quieter, explicit mute/unmute, or requested softer/louder speech.
excludes: Pausing playback or forbidding speech alone does not explicitly adjust loudness or a mute control. Current-setting inspection or opening controls alone is not adjustment.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request opening or displaying an audio-volume control interface.
includes: Explicitly open/show the volume controls or their settings interface.
excludes: Adjusting or asking current numerical values alone does not request an interface. Bare settings/control wording without an opening/display cue may be ambiguous.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request information about personal calendar events, reminders or availability.
includes: Existing entries, schedules, free time and event details.
excludes: Public event discovery and current clock time alone are distinct; adding an event does not imply a query.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request removing or cancelling a personal calendar entry or reminder.
includes: Deletion of an appointment, reminder or specified set of entries.
excludes: Alarm removal and non-calendar list edits alone are outside this definition.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

authored_cards.definition: Request creating, scheduling or repeating a personal calendar event or reminder.
includes: Appointments, event reminders, and conventional do-not-let-me-forget constructions.
excludes: Querying availability alone is not creation; a bare event mention can leave the act unresolved.
authored_cards.coexistence: Separate expressed acts may coexist. Exclusions apply to acts, not a veto on other clauses. No hierarchy closure or native-class precedence is inferred.

native_review_coverage.disposition: heterogeneous_native_category; persona is only one review lead, evaluate every source under all registered semantics, not all-negative

truth_policy: Every card must be judged from evidence; review leads never select runtime Q, infer negatives or prove class coverage.
overlap_policy: Overlaps explicit; broad factual property and audio adjustment can coexist with specific cards. No automatic parent/child closure, semantic complement or one-hot projection. Per-family reward budget fixed independent of ontology size.
scope: All60 native classes have review leads; finite semantic inventory is not exhaustive of every utterance or domain. Whole-population supervision and independent boundary review still required.
